_comment: Optional #1804 resting-memory protocol; local book is not a required corpus.
Cold settings/cache per launch; single-page mode; 30 page changes at runner cadence.
The two idle steps request 45 seconds each after paging settles. Journal monotonicMs
must be used for actual elapsed time: settling and boundary sampling add overhead.
Do not force trim or collection: confirm natural cacheTrimRequests/heapReclaims in metrics.
Deactivation stops the idle timer. A run with no idle heap reclaim is not a post-reclaim
baseline and must be repeated or reported separately, even if a deactivation trim fired.
Compare footprint with live/committed managed heap, single-page/continuous cache bytes
and native vmmap categories. Unattributed bytes are not proof of a retained owner.
Three repeats bound observed spread; an improvement still needs calibrated noise floors.
W9 is the same-mode form floor, not a 30-page workload. Preview comparisons require a separate
same-machine same-timing reader benchmark. These scenarios cannot establish that ratio.
The book's final 45-second diagnostic window permits a dump after the timed samples.
A capture during that window must not be used to reinterpret the earlier timed readings.

scenarios.why: #1804 same-mode small-form floor at approximately 45/90 seconds after settling; distinguishes fixed app cost from document/paging cost.
#1804 real 126-page IRS instructions, 30 page changes, then approximately 45/90 seconds after settling; replaces the invalid pre-trim idle20s resting reading.
#1804 real 455-page Business Success with Open Source book, 30 page changes, then approximately 45/90 seconds after settling; optional local personal-copy corpus.
